name: Jahanara Begum
contribution: A princess of the Mughal Empire.
legacy: She is known for her written works as well, which continue to be a primary way in which her presence in Sufism survives until today.

checks.lead: Jahanara Begum (23 March 1614 – 16 September 1681) was a princess of the Mughal Empire. She was the second and the eldest surviving child of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal.
